visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing light blue jeans and a light blue long-sleeved shirt holds a pale green, vertically ribbed towel. They stand in a bright, modern room with light-colored wood flooring and white walls. In the background, a white kitchen with minimalist cabinets and a small wooden dining set is visible under warm overhead lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a white, height-adjustable side table with a tablet resting on a white stand. The tablet displays a video of military tanks. Behind the table, a large television and a black Godzilla figurine sit on a low wooden console. (3) Two side tables are placed side-by-side against white closets. One has a light wood top and the other a white top. Both feature a white, C-shaped metal base with wheels. The creator's hand enters to demonstrate the white table's lever. (4) A close-up shows a hand pulling a white lever under the tabletop. The table smoothly rises via a gas-lift mechanism. Sparkle graphic overlays appear to emphasize ease of use. (5) The wooden-topped table is pushed to a dining table to extend its surface. The white table is then shown in the living room with takeout boxes on it. (6) The table is adjusted to match a kitchen island's height. The low-profile 3cm base is shown sliding under a grey sofa and a white bed. (7) A split-screen shows the 65-105cm height range. The white tabletop is folded down for storage, then tilted to hold a tablet. (8) The tables are shown in a laundry room and a home office next to a desk with a monitor and printer. The final shot returns to the dining room for a promo.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Solution Presentation -> Functional Feature List -> Real-world Use Cases -> Promotional CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional showcase for a FlexiSpot height-adjustable side table. It aims to solve the problem of limited space in post-childbirth households by demonstrating the table's mobility, adjustability, and versatility across different rooms (living room, kitchen, bedroom, office) to encourage viewers to join a group-buy promotion.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product features, visual branding of 'FlexiSpot', and a clear call to action for a group-buy.
